name: Violet Hearts: Blackwood Keep
source: You're asked to heal a dying man, only to discover you're tied to something far more dangerous than you realize. Can you save the demon and uncover the secrets of your past without being taken by dark magic?
translation: 你被要求治愈一个垂死的人，却发现你被绑在比你意识到的更危险的东西上。你能拯救恶魔并揭开你过去的秘密而不被黑魔法夺走吗？
